agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/tokens.py: _TokenType.__getattr__ was missing the dunder-attribute guard implied by its comment ('don't mess with dunder'), so accessing dunder attributes like __deepcopy__ dynamically created a new _TokenType instead of raising AttributeError. This caused copy.deepcopy() on Token objects to fail with 'TypeError: _TokenType object is not callable' (issue672 regression). Added `if name.startswith('__') and name.endswith('__'): raise AttributeError` at the top of __getattr__. Verified: copy.deepcopy(sqlparse.tokens.Token.Keyword) now works, and the check tool reports 0 failing / 3 passing for the reported behavior. Normal dynamic token attribute access (e.g. Token.Keyword) remains unaffected.
